findings.defect: The greeting is rendered as praise from a superior rather than courteous thanks from the official to the returning Hunters.
findings.rationale: 고생하셨습니다 expresses respectful appreciation for someone’s effort or hardship; it does not mean the speaker is evaluating their work.
findings.replacement: “Oh, thank you for your hard work.”

findings.current: As I watched him disappear with unsteady steps, Im Kkeokjeong asked me,
findings.defect: The translation omits Taekyung’s satisfaction as he watches Changsoo stagger away.
findings.rationale: 흐뭇하게 explicitly describes Taekyung watching with satisfaction, an important part of the scene’s comic characterization.
findings.replacement: As I watched with satisfaction as he staggered away, Im Kkeokjeong asked me,
findings.source: 비틀거리는 걸음으로 멀어지는 녀석의 뒷모습을 흐뭇하게 지켜보고 있던 내게 임꺽정이 물었다.

findings.current: “Impressive? He certainly is. Bloodlines are a frightening thing.”
findings.defect: The current version makes the repeated praise refer to Im Chunsoo and adds that bloodlines are frightening, while the source pivots the praise itself toward the power of heredity.
findings.rationale: 핏줄이라는 게 retroactively identifies bloodline or heredity as what is remarkable; the source does not call bloodlines frightening.
findings.replacement: “Impressive? It certainly is—the power of bloodlines, that is.”

findings.current: “We didn’t cause some huge mess, did we?”
findings.defect: The translation changes Taekyung’s singular responsibility to collective responsibility and adds the unsupported magnitude “huge.”
findings.rationale: The omitted Korean subject is Taekyung in context: he is worried that his own bet and treatment of Changsoo may have caused an incident.
findings.replacement: “I didn’t just cause trouble, did I?”

findings.current: “Some time ago, your son asked me to inform him if he ever used any of the bank’s services…”
findings.defect: The requester and recipient are reversed: the draft says Changsoo asked to be notified about his own transactions, contradicting why the manager reports them to Im Chunsoo.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exchange establishes that Im Chunsoo previously instructed the manager to notify him about Changsoo’s banking activity.
findings.replacement: “Some time ago, you asked me to let you know whenever your son used any of the bank’s services…”
findings.source: “일전에 아드님께서 은행 관련 업무를 이용하게 되면 꼭 알려 달라고 하셔서…….”

findings.current: “It must be another woman. Obvious. How much?”
findings.defect: The English is unnatural and reduces 계집질, Changsoo’s habitual womanizing or spending on women, to the mere existence of another woman.
findings.rationale: 계집질 is a disparaging reference to habitual womanizing, and 또 marks this as repeated behavior.
findings.replacement: “He must be fooling around with women again. Obviously. How much?”

findings.current: “Forty billion won to each of two accounts. Eighty billion won in total.”
findings.rationale: 40억 won is four billion won, and 80억 won is eight billion won.
findings.replacement: “Four billion won to each of two accounts. Eight billion won in total.”

findings.rationale: 80억 won is eight billion won; 헙 is a sharp involuntary intake of breath rather than the spoken word “Gasp.”

findings.current: There was no doubt that the documents contained the whereabouts of eighty billion won.
findings.replacement: There was no doubt that the documents contained the whereabouts of eight billion won.
findings.source: 저 안에 80억의 행방이 들어 있을 게 분명했다.

findings.current: “What a pathetic fool. Even after I warned him so many times…”
findings.defect: The translation adds an unsupported quantity by saying Im Chunsoo warned him “so many times.”
findings.rationale: 그리 describes what or how he warned Changsoo, not the number of warnings.
findings.replacement: “What a pathetic fool. Even after I warned him…”

summary: The draft contains a critical subject reversal in the bank manager’s explanation and three critical tenfold currency errors, along with several localized register, characterization, and fidelity issues.
